newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar mixed as NY fails to inspire.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar mixed as NY fails to inspire.

text.p: London's spot October white sugar contract held steady in a tight $1.40 range on Friday afternoon and was still reluctant to test nearby $330 resistance, traders said.
By 1515 GMT traded positions were unchanged to slightly firmer, with traders complaining of lacklustre performances on both the London and New York markets.

Earlier, market sources said they expected a renewal of fund interest in October raws as London was lacklustre after the withdrawal of fund buying which pushed October to a new contract high of $331.00 on July 28.
Interest was also noted in Oct/Oct arbitrage trading, with the nearby premium dipping to $70 at one stage. It started close to $72.50 earlier in the week.
"For the time being people are looking to come in and sell -- if it breaks $70.00 I think there'll be more selling," one trader said recently.
October was down 10 cents at $327.90 while December was unchanged at $323.40. Volume totalled 1,081 lots, half of which was in October.
The Paris market was marginally weaker but activity was minimal with just 182 lots traded.
October was down 50 cents at $328.00 and December down 30 cents at $323.20.
